# DIAGNOSIS OF PERTUSSIS

Pertussis is a clinical diagnosis with two weeks of cough and at least on other
symptoms of pertussis such as paroxysms or post tussive vomiting. Lab testing is
not required but available
For previously unvaccinated individuals, the three-dose serious of Td/Tdap
should be administered. A Tdap booster should be administered every 10 years
after completion of the series.
